note: Panel presentation per app. `name` -> discovered io_<name>/ bundle under ACTIVE/ (all content — description, stat, links, tags, thumbnail — lives there). Optional: an app with no entry here still ships, at 1x1. Fields here are design-only: size ('<cols>x<rows>', each 1-3, default '1x1'), paint ('red'|'teal'|'amber'; defaults from the first tag, then from the name), weight (0-3, curator emphasis, currently unused by the livery). Array order = display order on the deck.
